$comment: The rive-mcp commit this repo builds rigs with and measures them against. Rigging is generated, not authored (art-pipeline.md section 3), and the generator lives in another repository — so 'which version' has until now been tribal knowledge carried in commit messages. It is pinned here because the CLI plays two different roles and both of them want a fixed version. As a BUILDER its output is committed: a rig regenerated by a different version is a different binary, and the manticore mesh bug (art-pipeline.md section 6.4) is what a silently-moving builder looks like. As a RENDERER it is the measuring instrument for art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and a measuring instrument that drifts turns a green gate into a coin toss — the rest floor is 99.80% and two manticore tiers sit at 99.97%, so there is 0.17 points of room for a renderer that rasterises differently. CI reads `ref` from this file, so bumping the renderer is a visible commit that runs every gate against the new one rather than a change nobody can see. Bump it deliberately: `npm run art:rig:setup` builds the CLI at the new ref, `npm run art:rig:build` rebuilds the rigs, then run art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and commit the pin with whatever the rebuild changed. `npm run art:rig:build -- --check` is how the pin and the committed rigs are known to agree: it rebuilds all 54 with the pinned CLI and compares bytes, and CI runs it on any pull request that touches a rig input, this file included.
$refComment: rive-mcp PR #8 head (563c138): the `batch` command (one browser for every render/events/rig job — the gates and art:rig:build run on it), config validation with `lint-config`/`--strict`, the motion profile (`roles`, `motion`), and @rive-app/canvas-advanced pinned to 2.39.1 — the runtime the game ships, so the instrument measures the renderer players see. Byte-identical output for every committed rig from the previous pin (1bfca3d): art:rig:build --check 54/54, rest gate 54/54 with unchanged percentages, motion gate 702 clips PASS. When #8 lands on rive-mcp/main, move this to the merge commit and run --check again — a squash gives the same tree a new sha, and a sha only a deleted branch reaches is not a pin.
